id: 18_What is a laboratory report laboratory report microbiology lecture
title: 实验报告怎么写：从记录到安全
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/18_What is a laboratory report laboratory report microbiology lecture.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/18_What is a laboratory report laboratory report microbiology lecture/src.py

points.K7: 材料与方法：写到别人能重复
points.K13: 报告的作用：理解、重复、接着做

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一本空白记录本站在微生物实验室门口
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a microbiology teaching lab, holding a notebook with a blank cover, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天聊聊实验报告怎么写。
overlay: 实验报告怎么写：从记录到安全

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现报告、图表和星星三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to three floating icons: a stapled report, a bar chart and a star.
shots.narration: 它由哪几部分组成，各写什么。

shots.scene: 阿杰做完细菌培养实验，坐在桌前对着空白文档发愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a desk after a bacteria culture class, staring at a blank document on a laptop and scratching his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰做完培养实验，要交报告了。

shots.scene: 阿杰不知道从哪里下笔
shots.prompt_en: The young male student taps his pen on the desk, unsure where to start.
shots.narration: 他不知道该从哪儿写起。

shots.scene: 小研拿着一份装订好的报告走过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a neatly stapled report with a blank cover.
shots.narration: 小研说：报告有固定的结构。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 我们先看看，报告到底是什么。

shots.scene: 一份装订好的报告封面空白，旁边是试管和烧瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A stapled report with a blank cover lies beside test tube and flask icons on a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 实验报告，是一份详细的文件，

shots.scene: 报告翻开，一边是实验台缩略图，一边是图表
shots.prompt_en: An open report: one page shows a small sketch of a lab bench, the other shows simple charts with no text. No people.
shots.narration: 描述实验室里做过的一项实验，

shots.scene: 小研在桌前写报告，一边对照数据
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes a report at her desk while checking a printed data sheet with blank cells.
shots.narration: 还要对它做出分析。

shots.scene: 四个打勾的方框依次亮起：靶心、齿轮、柱状图、星星
shots.prompt_en: Four check boxes light up one by one beside icons: a target, a gear, a bar chart and a star. No people.
shots.narration: 报告由几个关键部分组成，

shots.scene: 靶心和齿轮图标放大
shots.prompt_en: The target icon and the gear icon grow larger side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 说清为什么做、怎么做，

shots.scene: 柱状图和星星图标放大
shots.prompt_en: The bar chart icon and the star icon grow larger side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 得到了什么、有什么意义。

shots.scene: 一排向下的黄色箭头，指向七个空白方框
shots.prompt_en: A row of yellow arrows pointing down to seven blank boxes arranged in order. No people.
shots.narration: 一份标准报告，大致是这样的结构：

shots.scene: 方框继续出现，最后两个亮起
shots.prompt_en: The last blank boxes light up at the end of the row, completing the sequence. No people.
shots.narration: 后面接讨论和结论。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着排好序的方框
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points along the row of boxes from left to right.
shots.narration: 再加上参考文献和必要的附录。

shots.scene: 报告封面上方一行空白标题框被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A report cover with one blank title bar highlighted at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 先说标题。

shots.scene: 阿杰写了一长串字，又划掉，改成短短一行
shots.prompt_en: The young male student crosses out a very long line on a draft and replaces it with one short line, shown as blank strokes.
shots.narration: 用一句话，简明说出实验的重点。

shots.scene: 长条标题图标打叉，短标题图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a very long title bar with a red cross, and a short title bar with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不绕弯，不堆砌。

shots.scene: 一页报告被压缩成一张小卡片
shots.prompt_en: A thick report shrinks down into one small blank card. No people.
shots.narration: 摘要，是整篇报告的缩影。

shots.scene: 小卡片上四个小图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: The small card shows four tiny icons in a row: a target, a gear, a bar chart and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 目的、方法、结果和结论，

shots.scene: 老周拿起卡片快速浏览，点点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man picks up the small card, glances over it quickly and nods.
shots.narration: 读者看一眼摘要，就知道你做了什么。

shots.scene: 书架和一本打开的书，书上有灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: A bookshelf and an open book with a light bulb icon above it. No people.
shots.narration: 引言，交代实验的背景和目的，

shots.scene: 从书本伸出一条箭头指向实验台
shots.prompt_en: An arrow runs from an open book to a lab bench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 说明为什么值得做这个实验，

shots.scene: 问号变成一个带问号的假设气泡
shots.prompt_en: A big question mark turns into a speech bubble containing a smaller question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 最后提出假设或者研究问题。

shots.section_title: 材料与方法：写到别人能重复
shots.scene: 实验台上排列的器材：培养皿、移液器、培养箱图标
shots.prompt_en: Lab equipment laid out on a bench: culture dishes, a pipette and an incubator, all with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 材料与方法，要写得很详细：
overlay: 材料与方法：写到别人能重复

shots.section_title: 材料与方法：写到别人能重复
shots.scene: 清单上三类图标：试剂瓶、仪器、步骤箭头
shots.prompt_en: A checklist with three groups of icons: reagent bottles, an instrument, and numbered step arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 用了什么材料、仪器，按什么步骤。

shots.section_title: 材料与方法：写到别人能重复
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着小研的报告，在另一张实验台上照做
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a report and follows it step by step at another bench, wearing a lab coat and gloves.
shots.narration: 清楚到别人照着写的就能重做一遍。

shots.scene: 表格、柱状图和照片图标依次出现
shots.prompt_en: A blank table, a bar chart and a photo frame icon appear one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 结果部分，呈现收集到的数据，

shots.scene: 小研把培养皿照片和计数表贴进报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a culture dish photo and a blank count table into a report on her laptop.
shots.narration: 可以用表格、图表和图片来展示。

shots.scene: 一张数据表旁，“解释”气泡被推到后面一页
shots.prompt_en: A data table on one page, while a thought bubble is moved to the next page. No people.
shots.narration: 这里只摆事实，先不解释。

shots.scene: 小研对着图表思考，头顶有思考气泡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student studies a chart with a thoughtful look, a thought bubble above her head.
shots.narration: 讨论部分，分析和解释结果。

shots.scene: 假设气泡和数据图并排，中间是对勾和叉号
shots.prompt_en: A hypothesis bubble beside a data chart, with a check mark and a cross between them. No people.
shots.narration: 结果支持假设吗？要说清楚。

shots.scene: 图表中一个点偏离其他点，被放大镜圈出
shots.prompt_en: A scatter chart where one dot sits far away from the others, circled by a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 有异常或意外，也要分析原因。

shots.scene: 报告和书架上的书之间连出几条线
shots.prompt_en: Lines connect the report to several books on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 再把发现和已有的知识对照。

shots.scene: 一颗星星从报告中升起
shots.prompt_en: A star rises out of an open report. No people.
shots.narration: 结论，总结主要发现和它的意义。

shots.scene: 路标图标指向前方的两条路
shots.prompt_en: A signpost icon pointing to two paths ahead. No people.
shots.narration: 还可以提出下一步研究或应用。

shots.scene: 报告末页上一列整齐的空白条目
shots.prompt_en: The last page of a report with a neat list of blank entries. No people.
shots.narration: 参考文献，列出报告里引用的全部来源。

shots.scene: 报告里的小编号和末页条目连线对应
shots.prompt_en: Small numbers in the report text are connected by lines to matching entries on the last page. No people.
shots.narration: 引了谁的，就要标出来，一一对应。

shots.scene: 报告后面夹着一叠附页
shots.prompt_en: A report with a stack of extra pages clipped behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 附录，有需要时才加。

shots.scene: 附页上是原始数据表和计算草稿图标
shots.prompt_en: The extra pages show a raw data table icon and a calculation sketch icon. No people.
shots.narration: 放补充数据和计算，正文不必塞满。

shots.section_title: 报告的作用：理解、重复、接着做
shots.scene: 报告传给几位同学，他们依次阅读
shots.prompt_en: A report is passed from the female graduate student to the young male student and another student, who read it in turn.
shots.narration: 实验报告，把研究过程记录下来，
overlay: 报告的作用：理解、重复、接着做

shots.section_title: 报告的作用：理解、重复、接着做
shots.scene: 三个台阶：眼睛、循环箭头、向上箭头
shots.prompt_en: Three steps like a staircase with icons: an eye, a circular arrow, and an upward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 让别人看得懂、能重复、接着做。

shots.section_title: 报告的作用：理解、重复、接着做
shots.scene: 教室、研究所大楼、工厂实验室三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons side by side: a classroom, a research institute building and a factory laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 课堂、科研院所、企业实验室都离不开它。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在九个方框组成的结构图前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a diagram of nine blank boxes in a row.
shots.narration: 一起回顾一下。

shots.scene: 结构图的九个方框依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The nine boxes light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 报告九部分，各有各的任务。

shots.scene: 表格和放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A data table icon and a magnifying glass icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 结果摆事实，讨论再解释。

shots.scene: 阿杰交上写好的报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a finished report to the older man.
shots.narration: 写清楚，让别人能理解、能重复。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研一起挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 写好报告，下次见！
